# Cinematic colour-grade variants

Created with the built-in image editing tool from `gurugram-desk-model-car.png`. The original remains unchanged.

All variants used the same preservation instructions: retain the original portrait composition, model car, headlights, licence plate, monitor, keyboard, headphones, plant, desk, focus plane, bokeh, textures, and every object; change only colour and tone.

## 01 — Moody blue-hour cinema

Deep neutral blacks, controlled cool navy shadows, subdued saturation, gentle highlight roll-off, a subtle warm countertone in the car interior and wood shelf, and natural chrome detail.

## 02 — Warm analogue film

Soft tungsten highlights, neutral charcoal shadows, restrained greens, creamy whites, gentle filmic contrast, and subtle fine grain while preserving believable blue headlights.

## 03 — Restrained teal and amber

Cool slate shadows, clean neutral midtones, delicate warm highlights, controlled blue headlights, subtle separation around the black car, and smooth cinematic contrast.
